items:
Location: Rosemary Beach
Address: Hopetown Lane

Hi, we are Susan and Jon Amsler, owners of Amsler Cottage in Rosemary Beach. We provide personal service that only an owner can. Our attention and knowledge combined with that of a local concierge is the best of both worlds.

LOCATION- LOCATION-LOCATION
- ONLY FIVE HOUSES FROM BEACH ACCESS.

- DIRECTLY ON PEDESTRIAN BOARDWALK "F"

- ONE MINUTE STROLL TO BEACH OR TOWN

- ALL 4 BEDROOMS HAVE FULL EN SUITE BATHS

- GULF VIEW FROM SECOND STORY BALCONY

- 4 ADULT BIKES/ BEACH CHAIRS/BEACH WAGON

- 55" SMART TV IN LIVING ROOM WITH HBO AND NETFLIX

- 3 RELAXING COVERED PORCHES, 1 SCREENED

- ACCESS TO ROSEMARY BEACH AND ALL FOUR BEAUTIFUL POOLS

-ACCESS to GYM and TENNIS ( + FEE)

- HIGH SPEED WIRELESS INTERNET

- SPACIOUS AND BEAUTIFULLY FURNISHED

- PRIVATE WALLED COURTYARD AREA WITH GAS GRILL /OUTDOOR DINING

- OUTDOOR PRIVATE SHOWER

- DEDICATED PARKING SPOTS, plus a parking pass for a 4th car.

- NO SHARING OUTDOOR SPACE OR PARKING WITH CARRIAGE HOUSE GUESTS *Very important!!!*

- ACCESS TO EXPERIENCED OWNER AND A LOCAL CONCIERGE SERVICE

- RENT FROM A LONG-TERM, KNOWLEDGEABLE OWNER

It is our goal to make your stay in Rosemary Beach a fantastic experience. We know that communication and attention to detail are what separates the good from the great.

Our rental rates are determined by the comparable homes directly around us. We can undercut our neighbor’s rates since we do not pay a management commission.

You will be delighted with this gorgeous SOUTH of 30-A home.

The front of the house faces one of Rosemary’s charming pedestrian wooden boardwalks. (boardwalk F).
We are near the town center, the Western Green and the gorgeous Gulf.

4 BEDROOMS/ 5 FULL BATHROOMS plus private outdoor shower with hot water. All bedrooms have private en-suite baths.

First Floor Bedroom, Queen Bed, double trough sink, shower, TV

Second Floor Bedroom, King Bed, Double sink , shower, TV, porch

Second Floor Bedroom, Queen bed, tub/shower combo, TV, screened in porch

Second Floor Bunkroom, 4 extra long twin beds, tub/shower combo

There is an additional full bathroom on the first floor plus a private outdoor shower.

Professionally decorated, the interior is comfortable and elegant Unique lighting fixtures, organic fabrics and bespoke furnishings with hardwood floors throughout. Mahogany French doors, custom finishes, and seagrass rugs create an upscale ambiance.

The first floor has three sets of mahogany French doors facing a pedestrian only boardwalk. Watch as people stroll or bike down the boardwalk to the beach while dining, watching TV or reading in front of the gas fireplace. A front porch with a swing and additional seating are a great place to relax and watch the world go by.


KITCHEN
The fully equipped gourmet kitchen features quartz countertops, Bosch dishwasher, gas burner stove , a separate beverage fridge and custom made cabinetry. Seating for 8 at the dining table as well as counter top seating for 2.

Also on the first floor is a guestroom with a queen bed for those that prefer not to climb stairs. Crisp linens dress the bed and there is a beautiful full en suite bath. Travertine, a double trough sink and a rain head shower make this bathroom a true spa experience.

There is an additional interior full bath on the first floor for everyone,( the fifth one), which has a unique connecting indoor-outdoor shower. The laundry is also conveniently located on the first floor.

SECOND FLOOR
The second floor has 3 bedrooms, all with private en suite baths. Unlike many other Rosemary homes, no beds are built into busy hallways or under stairs. There are no roll aways , sofa beds, or futons. All beds are supplied with high quality mattresses and linens.

The master suite holds a romantic king size canopy bed . Mahogany French doors lead out onto a porch with Gulf views and comfortable furniture. The large master bath has unique double custom made sinks, travertine floors and a large shower.

The bunk room has 4 individual custom built, extra long twin beds and an en suite bath with tub and shower. Each bunk has its own light, curtains and charging outlets. It is ideally suited for kids but we have had many happy adults sleep there as well.

The fourth guest room has a beautiful white antique queen bed and mahogany french doors leading to a screened- in porch with fans and a custom made hanging swing bed for naps. This room also has an en suite bath with tub and shower.

THIRD FLOOR
Up a spiral staircase to the third floor is an extra space for those occasional rainy days. Featuring a built in daybed and a TV, it is a great space for kids to hang out or a private retreat for working. Books, games and children's movies are provided.

EXTERIOR
The back courtyard is walled and has a built in natural gas grill, comfortable dining at a custom made table and a soothing fountain.

We chose not to build a Carriage House, a HUGE plus for our guests. Most of Rosemary Beach homes have a garage/carriage house that is adjacent and rented separately. Unless you rent both structures, parking options are reduced. Even more importantly, there is no sharing of outdoor space with whomever might be staying in the carriage house. At Amsler Cottage, exterior space is yours alone to enjoy.

We have included the general floor plans in the photo section. Our guests' comfort is our priority and the layout needs to work for your needs.

Overseen by local 30A Cottages, experience contactless check in and first class service.
High grade sheets and towels as well as organic bath and toiletries are provided by the concierge. Should you need or want anything, a staff member can be on hand.

POOLS/TENNIS/FITNESS CENTER
There are 4 beautiful community pools. The two closest to us are each @ a 5 minute walk.
The tennis and fitness center are available for a fee. (Even homeowners are required to pay for these amenities).

PARKING
There are 3 available spaces on property as well as a pass provided for street parking if an additional 4th car is needed. A parking map and detailed instructions will be emailed to you prior to arrival. Most homes in Rosemary only have one dedicated space for the main house and one for the carriage house.

BIKES
Four adult beach cruisers are included with the house. Baskets and locks provided as well. Additional bikes can be rented.

If you have never been to the area or if this is already your happy place, we promise to give you the personal attention you deserve. It is our hope that you will be enchanted with the magic of Rosemary Beach. If you have any questions, I will be happy to help you figure out if our home is the right fit.

On the beach side of 30-A, directly on pedestrian boardwalk to Gulf.
